product.name: Regular Fit Textured Shirt
product.description: Regular-fit shirt in woven, textured fabric with a comfortable, classic silhouette. Button-down collar, classic button placket, open chest pocket, and yoke at back. Long sleeves, sleeve placket with link button, and adjustable buttoning at cuffs. Gently rounded hem.
